intro: Relation activity and time on a daily schedule. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Relation activity and time on a daily schedule. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention: « De… à… » marks the interval and « le » can point to the days when an activity is repeated. In this fragment, «lundi» means «Monday».

frases.fr: La bibliothèque ouvre à neuf heures du lundi au vendredi.
frases.es: La biblioteca abre a las nueve de lunes a viernes.
frases.en: The library opens at 9: 00 Monday to Friday.

frases.fr: Le mercredi, l'atelier de lecture commence à quinze heures.
frases.es: El miércoles, el taller de lectura empieza a las tres de la tarde.
frases.en: On Wednesday, the reading workshop starts at 3: 00 in the afternoon.

frases.fr: La bibliothèque ferme à dix-huit heures, sauf le samedi.
frases.es: La biblioteca cierra a las seis, excepto los sábados.
frases.en: The library closes at six, except on Saturdays.

frases.fr: Le samedi, elle ferme à midi et reste fermée le dimanche.
frases.es: El sábado cierra al mediodía y permanece cerrada el domingo.
frases.en: Saturday closes at noon and remains closed on Sunday.
